verses.1: And Sarah, the wife of Abraham, did not give birth to any children for him. Instead, she gave birth to a daughter from Egypt, and her name was Hagar.
verses.2: And the servant said to Abraham, “Please, let me be freed from this situation. Please take my wife away from me.” Abraham heard the voice of his servant.
verses.3: And Sarah took the Egyptian woman, Abraham’s wife, from twelve years old onward. She became Abraham’s wife.
verses.4: And she went to the stranger. She stood up and saw that her dress was torn. Her body became limp in front of his eyes.
verses.5: And the priest said to Abraham, “Hurry up! I have given you your wife as a gift. But now, see that she is pregnant. Then Jehovah will judge between me and you.”
verses.6: And Abraham said to his servants, “Look, your wife is in your hands. Do whatever you think is right with her.” But the servants refused and ran away from her.
verses.7: And the angel of the LORD was seen on the surface of the water in the desert, on the shore along the shore.
verses.8: And the foreigner said to Sarah’s daughter, “Ei Mezeh, you have come here. I will go with you.” Then she said, “Before my husband, I am a fugitive.”
verses.9: And the angel of the LORD said to her, “Return to your master and rest under his wings.”
verses.10: And the LORD said to her, “Many will be the offspring of your seed, and no one will know their number.”
verses.11: And the LORD said to her, “Go, and have a son. Call his name Ishmael, for the LORD has heard your prayer.”
verses.12: And he will be a man who has authority over everything; everything will be under his control. And on the faces of all his brothers, he will sit.
verses.13: And the name of Jehovah, the Speaker, was called to her. “You are the Lord,” she said. “For I have seen Him after my vision.”
verses.14: Therefore, it was called “the river of life.” Now, see how it lies between the holy and the profane.
verses.15: And Hagar gave birth to a son for Abraham. Abraham named his son Ishmael.
verses.16: And Abraham, son of Sarah, was seventy years old when Ishmael was born to him.
